_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative lifecycle (active, paused), imperative scheduled bulk work in ScheduledReportJob
_meta.description: ReportSchedule: a catalogue report that ScheduledReportJob produces on its own, files in a folder of the schedule owner's storage shared with the recipients, and announces with a notification. The owner is the object's OpenRegister owner, never a payload field, and a run is refused when the owner cannot reach the administration.

ReportSchedule.title: Report schedule
ReportSchedule.description: A report from the report library that is produced and delivered on its own, weekly, monthly or quarterly.

administrationId.description: The administration the report is produced for.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

name.description: A name for the schedule, for lists.
name.title: Name

reportType.description: The report library entry to produce, by its id in the report catalogue.
reportType.title: Report

format.description: The file format to produce. A format the report cannot produce falls back to its first format.
format.title: Format

frequency.description: How often the report is produced.
frequency.title: Frequency

runDay.description: The day it runs: a day of the month (1 to 28) for a monthly or quarterly schedule, a weekday (1 Monday to 7 Sunday) for a weekly one. A quarterly schedule runs in the first month of each quarter.
runDay.title: Run day

periodRule.description: The period each run reports on: the week's month, month or quarter before the run, or the year up to the run.
periodRule.title: Period

items.description: A user as user:<id> or a group as group:<id>.
items.title: Recipient

recipients.description: Who receives the file and a notification: users as user:<id>, groups as group:<id>.
recipients.title: Recipients

folderPath.description: The folder in the schedule owner's files the reports are filed in.
folderPath.title: Folder

lastPeriod.description: The period the last run reported on.
lastPeriod.title: Last period

lastFilePath.description: Where the last report was filed.
lastFilePath.title: Last file

lastError.description: Why the last run failed. Empty after a run that worked.
lastError.title: Last error

status.description: Active schedules run; paused ones wait until resumed.
status.title: Status

active.label: Active
active.description: The schedule runs on its run day.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: The schedule does not run until it is resumed.

pause.label: Pause
pause.description: Stop producing the report until it is resumed.

resume.label: Resume
resume.description: Produce the report again from the next run day.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Who created, changed, paused and resumed each schedule, and when.
